column2: HAND-WRITTEN TEST FIXTURE — NOT GTDB-Tk OUTPUT.
Lineages for the smoke-test reference genomes, in GTDB-Tk summary.tsv shape
(user_genome + classification are the only columns panel_scored.py reads).
Written by hand because these are known type strains; running GTDB-Tk on them
would need the 100 GB reference data for no added confidence.
Real runs pass the actual gtdbtk.ar53.summary.tsv / gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv.
